note: Positions are local metres (x east, y north) of public/data/<city>/terrain.json's frame: x = x0 + (c % nx) * cell + qx / q, y = y0 + floor(c / nx) * cell + qy / q. Built by scripts/pack_lamps.py.

lampTypes._note: Street-lamp types for plan 02 (D5.3, section 7.8) and plan 01 (T4.0). Read by scripts/lib/lamps.py. `status` says which numbers come from a source and which are assumed. lmPerW may be a table by wattage (interpolated in log watts). class is the sky-glow class of plan 01, section 7.8: sodium, led or other.
lampTypes.mountDefaultNote: 30 ft pole: 66,572 of Clark County's 73,240 supports (POLE_HEIGHT, read 22 Nov 2026); the county LED specification gives 32 ft on an 8 ft arm

status.lmPerW: assumed: 9,500 / 27,500 / 50,000 lm at 100 / 250 / 400 W (plan 02, 7.8); 70, 150 and 1000 W interpolated from typical lamp catalogues
status.uplight: assumed: a few percent from drop-lens heads

status.cctK: verified for Clark County: 4,000 K +/- 300 K (county LED specification, plan 02 L2); assumed for the other jurisdictions
status.uplight: verified for Clark County: BUG U0; assumed elsewhere

status.cctK: assumed from the county roadway specification
status.mountM: Clark County supports: 70 ft for 323 and 100 ft for 110 poles; 70 ft is used when a fixture's support is not found

types.name: Metal halide (and floodlights of unrecorded type)
